record.question: There was such a large crowd at the entrance that we couldn't manage to get in. Identify the concept expressed by this sentence.
record.explanation: Answer D: Result. The “such ... that” construction gives the consequence: the crowd prevented entry. Independent check: The “such … that” clause gives the result of the crowd’s size: they could not get in. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/so-such. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
